caption: The drawing depicts a single ankle-high shoe oriented to the right, with a pointed toe and flat sole. The shoe is predominantly colored with alternating dark blue and red stripes running diagonally along its length, with the stripes following the contours of the shoe from the toe to the top of the ankle. A solid dark blue strip runs vertically along the front of the ankle section and extends to the sole, with what appears to be small, evenly spaced, dark blue buttons or fastenings attached along the edge. The upper line of the shoe opening is trimmed in dark blue as well. The sole is rendered in a brownish-yellow color, and the shoe is set against a plain, beige background with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "Adele Brooks," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Woman's Slipper
